fusions.name: Waterline Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges at the target for 32 damage, always a critical hit. The target is left [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls an enemy at or below 30% health for 24 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.8 times their remaining damage, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Motionless Hour
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second cast, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: From the Shallows

riders.text: you close across it faster than over ground
and blows aimed at you on it go wide
and you get your wind back while you wait on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 12% faster on it, from silver your dodge chance rises 8% on it, and from gold your stamina recovers 25% faster on it.
